docs.summary: Bridge between the runtime [`MeshFeatureRegistry`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.MeshFeatures.MeshFeatureRegistry) and the editor [`ImportContext`](#api~Prowl.Editor.Importers.ImportContext). Walks every registered feature spec, asks it to generate a feature for the mesh, and registers the result as a read-only sub-asset.

members.name: GenerateAll
members.signature: public static void GenerateAll(IReadOnlyList<Mesh> meshes, EchoObject? settings, ImportContext ctx, IReadOnlyList<string> ownerIdentities)

docs.summary: Generate every enabled feature for each mesh and attach them as sub-assets. Sub-asset names are `{meshName}_{featureKey}` for deterministic GUIDs across reimports.

params.ownerIdentities: The sub-asset identity of each mesh, so each feature keys off its owner plus its own spec key. Registration order would not do here: a feature that stops generating shifts every later one onto the wrong GUID.
